Donna \(\to\) Adam \(\to\) Alan \(\to\) Natalie \(\to\) … \(\to\) Patrick \(\to\) Brian.  
Thus Donna is also an ancestor of Brian.  

Because a single individual (Donna) lies on the ancestor side of both Angela and Brian, Angela and Brian share a common ancestor.  

No path exists from Angela to Brian, so Angela cannot be Brian’s ancestor.  
No path exists from Brian to Angela, so Brian cannot be Angela’s ancestor.  
Brian is a terminal leaf and Angela has no descendants, so the two individuals share no common descendant.  

Hence only statement 1 holds.
